description: The two exhaustive Spanish Markdown tutorials (EXACTLY TWO, no third doc, no separate architecture file). 01-metricas-y-logs.md documents Part 1 end to end including the real AWS EC2 deployment; 02-trazas-distribuidas-opentelemetry-jaeger.md builds on Part 1 for Part 2. Diagrams are Mermaid embedded inside these files. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (documents the implemented code/config and uses verified AWS facts verbatim). The README.md created in FEAT-001 points here and does not count as a tutorial.
steps: Write 01-metricas-y-logs.md (Spanish, technical, pedagogical) sections IN ORDER: objetivos de aprendizaje; arquitectura + diagrama Mermaid del flujo de metricas y logs; requisitos previos; configuracion de AWS CLI y perfil `stay` (account 550428926318, user arn:aws:iam::550428926318:user/JuanHoyos, region us-east-1); creacion y configuracion de EC2 (t3.small AL2023 — justify why t3.micro 1GB is too small to run api+Prometheus+Loki+Grafana+agents and t3.small 2GB is the economical stable minimum; security group least-privilege scoped to the student public IP, showing how to obtain it with `curl -s https://checkip.amazonaws.com`; IAM role obs-lab-ec2-role least privilege; tags Project=obs-lab; reuse key pair ec2-docker-api-key or create new, explaining how); instalacion Docker + Docker Compose; creacion de la API FastAPI; instrumentacion de metricas; node_exporter; Prometheus; Loki + Alloy; Grafana; los dos dashboards; generacion de trafico; verificacion de metricas/logs/errores; troubleshooting; seguridad (puertos expuestos SSH 22 + Grafana 3000 to student IP, API 8000 optional; Prometheus/Loki/collector/Jaeger internal via SSH tunnel; proposito y quien accede); estimacion de costes (EC2, EBS, IP publica, transferencia; note stopping EC2 does NOT remove EBS/IP costs; no NAT/ALB); limpieza y eliminacion segura. Clarify node_exporter OS metrics vs CloudWatch (do not present node_exporter as CloudWatch-native).

Write 02-trazas-distribuidas-opentelemetry-jaeger.md (Spanish) building on Part 1 without repeating all initial steps, sections IN ORDER: objetivos; arquitectura de trazas + Mermaid; diferencias metrica vs log vs traza; diseno del recorrido de la peticion; implementacion del segundo servicio service-b + a short comparison TABLE with the Lambda alternative (Lambda needs ADOT layer + manual context propagation + a secure public collector endpoint + invocation cost) explaining why ALTERNATIVE B (container, ~0 extra cost, no public OTLP) was chosen; instrumentacion OpenTelemetry; propagacion de contexto (W3C traceparent); config del OTel Collector (OTLP in, otlp exporter to jaeger:4317, memory_limiter/batch/resource — note the native jaeger exporter was removed); despliegue de Jaeger (all-in-one, COLLECTOR_OTLP_ENABLED=true, UI 16686 via SSH tunnel); configuracion OTLP; ejecucion de peticiones de prueba; analisis de trazas y spans (how to confirm two services share one trace_id with parent-child spans); simulacion de latencia y errores; correlacion logs/metricas/trazas (end-to-end: anomaly in API metrics -> inspect Loki logs -> open related trace in Jaeger -> identify which service caused latency/error); verificacion; troubleshooting; seguridad y costes adicionales (~0 extra for container B); limpieza de recursos adicionales.

In BOTH tutorials, every step must state: que se hace, por que, el comando exacto, el directorio desde el que ejecutarlo, el resultado esperado, como comprobar que funciono, y que revisar si falla. No ambiguous placeholders like PEGA_AQUI_TU_IP without showing how to obtain the value (e.g. curl -s https://checkip.amazonaws.com). Do NOT fabricate command outputs as if really executed — label 'resultado esperado' distinctly from any verified result.
Ensure the README.md (from FEAT-001) links to both tutorials and that there are EXACTLY TWO tutorial markdown files at the repo root (no third doc, no separate architecture markdown).
acceptance_criteria: Exactly two tutorial markdown files exist at repo root: 01-metricas-y-logs.md and 02-trazas-distribuidas-opentelemetry-jaeger.md (plus README.md which is not a tutorial); no third tutorial/architecture markdown.

01 contains all required sections in the specified order, including the t3.micro-vs-t3.small justification, node_exporter-vs-CloudWatch clarification, least-privilege SG scoped to the student IP with the checkip command, cost estimate noting EBS/IP persist when EC2 is stopped, and safe cleanup.

02 contains all required sections in order, including the Lambda-vs-container-B comparison table, the collector->Jaeger OTLP wiring note (no native jaeger exporter), COLLECTOR_OTLP_ENABLED=true, and the metrics->logs->traces correlation walkthrough.

AWS facts (profile stay, account 550428926318, user JuanHoyos, us-east-1, key pair ec2-docker-api-key, prefix obs-lab, tag Project=obs-lab) appear verbatim; no PEGA_AQUI_TU_IP without an acquisition command; no fabricated command outputs.
verification: ls repo root and confirm exactly two tutorial .md files plus README.md: `ls *.md`
grep each tutorial for its required section headings and confirm order and presence (content check)
grep tutorials for forbidden placeholder: `grep -rn 'PEGA_AQUI_TU_IP' .` returns matches ONLY where immediately accompanied by the checkip command, else none
Manual review that commands match the actually-implemented files/services and that resultado esperado is distinguished from verified results
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. Wrote EXACTLY TWO Spanish Markdown tutorials at repo root; README.md (from FEAT-001) already links to both and is NOT a tutorial. No third tutorial/architecture markdown exists (only .venv/.pytest_cache third-party .md files, unrelated).

=== 01-metricas-y-logs.md ===
Secciones en orden (## 1-19): objetivos; arquitectura + diagrama Mermaid del flujo metricas/logs; requisitos previos; AWS CLI y perfil `stay` (account 550428926318, user arn:aws:iam::550428926318:user/JuanHoyos, region us-east-1, VPC vpc-059b7fcb3ae44690e); creacion EC2 (5.1 justificacion t3.small 2GiB vs t3.micro 1GiB demasiado pequena; 5.2 `curl -s https://checkip.amazonaws.com` para la IP; 5.3 Security Group least-privilege scoped a $MI_IP para 22/3000 y 8000 opcional; 5.4 IAM role obs-lab-ec2-role + instance profile least privilege; 5.5 key pair ec2-docker-api-key o nuevo; 5.6 run-instances t3.small AL2023, tag Project=obs-lab); Docker+Compose; API FastAPI (tabla de endpoints real de app/main.py incl. /simulate-error mode server|client, /simulate-slow cap 5s, /checkout); instrumentacion Prometheus (metricas reales de app/metrics.py, baja cardinalidad, histograma p50/p90/p99); node_exporter con aclaracion explicita node_exporter(SO) != CloudWatch; Prometheus (jobs reales de prometheus.yml); Loki+Alloy (campos de log reales de logging_config.py, regex de Alloy real); Grafana (UIDs prometheus/loki/jaeger); los dos dashboards (infra.json, api.json); generacion de trafico (scripts/load_test.py); verificacion; troubleshooting; seguridad puertos+tuneles SSH (tabla, 9090/3100/4317/16686 internos); estimacion de costes (EC2/EBS/IP/transfer; nota: stop NO elimina costes de EBS/IP, solo terminate+borrar volumen/IP; sin NAT/ALB); limpieza y eliminacion segura (terminate, borrar SG/volumen/IAM, no tocar soc-challenge-*/SocChallenge-*/lumen-production-*).

=== 02-trazas-distribuidas-opentelemetry-jaeger.md ===
Secciones en orden (## 1-18): objetivos; arquitectura de trazas + diagrama Mermaid; diferencias metrica vs log vs traza (tabla); diseno del recorrido Client->api->service-b->service-b.work; service-b con TABLA comparativa Lambda (ADOT layer + propagacion manual + endpoint OTLP publico seguro + coste por invocacion) vs ALTERNATIVA B (contenedor, ~0 coste extra, sin OTLP publico) y por que se eligio B; instrumentacion OpenTelemetry (SDK 1.27.0, 0.48b0, nota setuptools==75.*); propagacion W3C traceparent (httpx inyecta, FastAPI extrae); config OTel Collector (otlp in grpc 4317/http 4318, memory_limiter 256MiB/batch/resource, exporter otlp a jaeger:4317, nota: exportador nativo jaeger ELIMINADO en 0.109); despliegue Jaeger all-in-one 1.60 con COLLECTOR_OTLP_ENABLED=true, UI 16686 por tunel SSH; activar OTLP (OTEL_ENABLED=true); peticiones de prueba (/checkout, ?slow=1); analisis de trazas/spans (como confirmar un unico trace_id con spans padre-hijo en ambos servicios); simulacion de latencia y errores; correlacion metricas->logs->trazas end-to-end (anomalia en dashboard API -> Loki {service=obs-lab-api}|json status>=500 -> enlace derived field trace_id -> traza en Jaeger -> span service-b.work; vuelta via tracesToLogsV2); verificacion (tabla); troubleshooting; seguridad y costes adicionales (~0 extra, servicios internos); limpieza (Parte 2 no crea recursos AWS; remite a la limpieza de Parte 1).

=== REGLAS DE CALIDAD CUMPLIDAS ===
- Cada paso indica: que se hace, por que, comando exacto, directorio, resultado esperado, como comprobar, que revisar si falla.
- Sin PEGA_AQUI_TU_IP (el unico match del grep esta en .agents/tasks/plan.md, archivo de instrucciones, no en los tutoriales); la IP se obtiene siempre con `curl -s https://checkip.amazonaws.com`.
- Los bloques 'Resultado esperado' se distinguen explicitamente de resultados verificados; NO se fabrican salidas de comandos.
- Comandos y nombres (servicios, metricas, endpoints, UIDs, regex, puertos) verificados contra los archivos reales (app/, service-b/, config/, docker-compose.yml, scripts/).

=== VERIFICACION EJECUTADA ===
- `ls *.md` -> 01-metricas-y-logs.md, 02-trazas-distribuidas-opentelemetry-jaeger.md, README.md (exactamente dos tutoriales + README).
- grep de headings `^## ` confirma todas las secciones requeridas y su orden en ambos archivos.
- `grep -rn PEGA_AQUI_TU_IP . --include='*.md'` -> solo plan.md (instrucciones), ningun tutorial.
- find de *.md fuera de .agents/.git: no hay tercer tutorial/architecture markdown (los demas .md son de .venv/.pytest_cache).
